stories.title: Sonam Kapoor Turns Denim Into A Couture Statement In Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla's Embroidered Jeans - News18
Manipur textile heritage showcased in Madrid
stories.summary: Designer Robert Naorem presented a collection of Manipuri handloom and textiles at the India-Spain Festival in Madrid. The event, held at the Estación de Chamartín, aimed to promote cultural tourism and highlight indigenous craftsmanship. Twelve models walked the runway to showcase the state's traditional weaving techniques.

stories.title: Robert Naorem brings Manipuri handloom to Madrid
stories.summary: Fashion designer Robert Naorem showcased a collection featuring Manipur’s traditional handloom weaves and GI-tagged motifs at the India-Spain Festival in Madrid. The runway presentation aimed to introduce Northeast India's indigenous textile traditions to an international trade platform. The collection focused on contemporary applications of traditional designs.

stories.title: Limited Edt Opens At DLF Avenue, Bringing Singapore's Iconic Sneaker Culture To Delhi - IFAB MEDIA
Founders look to heritage for luxury growth
stories.summary: India's luxury market is seeing a shift as entrepreneurs blend heritage craftsmanship with modern business models. Founders are moving beyond traditional family-led structures to build brands focused on innovation and purpose. One entrepreneur noted that her brand began after struggling to find original handloom Paithani sarees.

stories.title: Tracing the history of Indian luxury
stories.summary: A new visual journey explores 4,000 years of Indian opulence, examining how gold, gemstones, and artisanal skills have defined wealth and identity. The history of Indian luxury is described as a lore of craftsmanship, distinct from the European tradition of luxury houses.

stories.title: Jewellers expect growth in wedding season
stories.summary: Sky Gold and Diamonds expects a stronger wedding season than last year, despite shifting consumer budgets. The company noted that buyers are becoming more selective regarding the weight, design, and format of their jewellery purchases. The wedding season remains a primary consumption period for the industry.

stories.title: Fynd partners with N Brown for retail automation
stories.summary: Mumbai-based AI company Fynd has partnered with UK retailer N Brown to integrate its Boltic platform for workflow automation. The deal follows the implementation of the India-UK trade agreement in July. This marks the company's first major investment in its expansion focus in the north.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector marks 80 years of independence
stories.summary: India’s manufacturing sector is highlighting its progress in defence, textiles, and pharmaceuticals under the Make in India vision. The government has introduced initiatives including the Production Linked Incentive scheme and the National Logistics Policy to position the country as a global industrial hub.

stories.title: Legendary Supermodel Veruschka, One of Fashion’s First Global Icons, Dies at 87 - Parade Magazine
Supermodel Veruschka dies at 87
stories.summary: German model Veruschka, described by Richard Avedon as the most beautiful woman in the world, has died at 87. Known for her ability to transform her appearance and contort her limbs for photography, she was considered one of fashion's original performance artists.

stories.title: A look back at the career of Veruschka
stories.summary: Archival images capture the career of model Veruschka von Lehndorff, from her appearances at 1970s social events to her attendance at the 2002 CFDA Awards. The collection documents her long-standing presence in the fashion industry across several decades.

stories.title: Guadagnino apologizes for costume design remarks
stories.summary: Filmmaker Luca Guadagnino apologized to costume designers at the Marrakech Film Festival for previous comments regarding his preference for working with fashion designers. He maintained his admiration for collaborator Jonathan Anderson, stating that fashion designers are in touch with the pulse of how we live.

stories.title: Ellen Mirojnick wins costume design award
stories.summary: The British Fashion Council named Ellen Mirojnick Costume Designer of the Year for her work on the film The Odyssey. Mirojnick created over 5,300 bespoke costumes for the production. The award will be presented at a ceremony in London on November 30.

stories.title: Burberry trench coat celebrates 170 years
stories.summary: The Burberry trench coat is marking its 170th anniversary with exhibitions and campaigns. The garment's success is attributed to the invention of gabardine, a fabric that helped transition the coat from a functional item to a luxury staple of British fashion.

stories.title: Meta announces AI grants for startups
stories.summary: Meta will provide $700,000 in funding through its AI Impact Grant for startups and developers in seven countries, including Nigeria, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia. The initiative supports businesses building solutions with Meta’s AI tools and wearable technologies, with the program scheduled to begin in 2027.

stories.title: FIT museum to host exhibition on queer identity
stories.summary: The Museum at the Fashion Institute of Technology will present an exhibition featuring designers Willy Chavarria and Bárbara Sánchez-Kane. Running from February to April 2027, the show will explore how queer identities and Mexican heritage influence creative practices through 60 objects, including garments and video.

stories.title: Native Made Market returns to Rochester
stories.summary: Rochester’s fifth annual Native Made Market will feature Indigenous artisans and fashion shows this weekend. The event aims to blend holiday shopping with cultural preservation. Organizers noted the urgency of supporting Native American traditions as tribal populations face decline.

stories.title: NYC Jewelry Week names inaugural high school award winner
stories.summary: Adrienne McMillan, a student at the Brooklyn STEAM Center, received the inaugural Here We Are High School Award during the annual NYC Jewelry Week festival. The award is sponsored by Rio Grande, a jewelry supply company owned by Berkshire Hathaway’s Richline Group. The festival concluded on Sunday.

stories.title: Rosec Jewels Confirms Black Friday and Cyber Monday Promotion Is Live Across Jewelry Collections - EIN News
High jewellery turns statement rings into sculptural art
stories.summary: Luxury houses are releasing oversized rings designed to span multiple fingers. Boucheron, Cartier, and Chanel have introduced collections featuring sculptural forms inspired by animals and symbolic motifs. The pieces are intended to be impossible to miss, assuming one has enough fingers to accommodate the design.

stories.title: Tamannaah Fine Jewellery partners with designer Rahul Mishra for Diwali show at Selfridges, London - The Retail Jeweller
Sotheby’s Showcases Ruby and Diamond Necklace at New York Sale - Rapaport
GIA names former Ben Bridge executive as VP of jewelry services
stories.summary: Regina Aiello has been appointed as the new vice president of jewelry services at GIA. Aiello previously served as vice president of sales innovation at Ben Bridge Jeweler. The role focuses on expanding the lab's expertise to finished jewelry, including metal verification and gemstone characteristics.

stories.title: Shine on: 24 engagement ring brands to take a fancy to - Vogue Australia
Dubai jewelry exhibition revives the lost art of Iron Age goldsmithing - Arab News
Syria gold jewelry industry faces modernization challenges
stories.summary: Syria currently operates approximately 430 gold jewelry workshops, with Damascus and Aleppo hosting the majority. The General Authority for Precious Metals Management reports that the industry faces significant hurdles regarding equipment upgrades, production methods, and regulatory oversight. The sector is currently working to meet approved market standards.

stories.title: Fossil Group Extends Michael Kors Licensing Deal To 2032 - WatchPro
Sampha soundtracks Chanel campaign
stories.summary: Chanel collaborated with musician Sampha Lahai Sisay to create the soundtrack for its seasonal watches and fine jewellery campaign. The film features a narrative of friendship set against a frozen landscape. The brand reached out to the artist to provide the musical score for the project.

stories.title: Emna Hussein is 3D-printing the Mediterranean into handbags
stories.summary: Fashion Trust Arabia finalist Emna Hussein is creating sculptural handbags using 3D-printed, plant-based plastic. Her designs incorporate traditional Tunisian jewelry aesthetics and materials like oyster shells. The winner of the Fashion Tech Award will be announced in Doha on November 28th.

stories.title: Infinix packs ZClip 2 Pro earbuds into a snack bag
stories.summary: Infinix is shipping its ZClip 2 Pro open-ear earbuds inside air-filled foil pouches designed to resemble snack packaging. The company describes the concept as Snack Aesthetics, aiming to turn the unboxing process into a reward ritual for a social-first generation that shares everything.

stories.title: Meta AI glasses are coming to South Africa
stories.summary: EssilorLuxottica and Meta will launch Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses in South Africa at the end of November. The companies describe the product as the world’s leading AI glasses and a cultural phenomenon. Users can use the device for hands-free capture and audio.

stories.title: Crafting stunning jewelry from everyday cutlery
stories.summary: A new DIY trend encourages the transformation of old utensils into handmade jewelry. The process involves repurposing everyday cutlery into accessories intended to showcase artistic flair. Enthusiasts are encouraged to find beauty in the everyday by turning kitchen tools into wearable items.

stories.title: Perfume necklaces are the latest fragrance trend
stories.summary: U.S. prestige fragrance sales rose 6 percent in the first half of 2026, according to Circana. Brands are now marketing perfume pendants as a practical alternative to carrying bottles. While the concept of wearable fragrance dates back to the 1300s, it is currently being rebranded as a necessity.

stories.title: The opera coat trend gains momentum
stories.summary: Conner Ives’s silk brocade opera coat, debuted at London Fashion Week, has sparked a trend for the garment. The pieces often feature historical textiles and intricate embroidery. The item has become a staple for those seeking to participate in the current fashion cycle.

stories.title: Tiffany HardWear collection gains consumer attention
stories.summary: The author details a personal decision to purchase multiple items from the Tiffany HardWear collection, including a link necklace and pavé earrings. The purchase is framed as a self-gifting moment during the holiday season. The collection is noted for its recognizable branding.

stories.title: India Targets $100 Bn Textile And Apparel Exports By FY31: BCG-CII Report - BW Businessworld
India loses apparel market share as global buyers diversify
stories.summary: India has failed to benefit from the global shift in apparel sourcing away from China, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group and the Confederation of Indian Industry. While China’s global export share dropped to 27 percent, Bangladesh and Vietnam gained ground as buyers consolidated their supply chains.

stories.title: US tariff probe threatens Indian garment exports
stories.summary: Indian garment exporters face potential new US duties as part of a Section 301 investigation into alleged excess capacity. The US Trade Representative has yet to issue final findings or rates, but the prospect of a second tariff could influence sourcing decisions compared to regional competitors like Vietnam.

stories.title: US tariff probe creates uncertainty for Indian apparel
stories.summary: Indian garment exporters may face a second US duty on top of existing tariffs as part of a Section 301 investigation into structural excess capacity. The US Trade Representative has not yet released final rates or product lists, leaving the industry to weigh its competitive advantage against regional rivals.

stories.title: Italian textile machinery makers target South Asian growth
stories.summary: Italian textile machinery manufacturers are promoting sales in South Asia, particularly India, to offset cautious demand from European textile finishers. The Association of Italian Textile Machinery Manufacturers is hosting promotional events ahead of the upcoming ITMA exhibition in Hanover to highlight new opportunities for their export sector.

stories.title: India’s man-made yarn prices decline amid weak demand
stories.summary: Polyester and viscose yarn prices have eased in major Indian markets due to sluggish demand and cheaper imports. While high inventories remain a concern, market participants are looking to the upcoming wedding season to stimulate downstream activity and improve payment flows across the sector.

stories.title: Indonesia wage hikes prompt apparel sourcing reassessment
stories.summary: Asia sourcing teams are being advised to build cost projections based on specific production zones rather than country-level averages. With wage increases varying significantly across the region, suppliers in Vietnam and Indonesia may seek price revisions from January to account for rising local labor costs.

stories.title: Denmark invests $550 million in Bangladesh port expansion
stories.summary: APM Terminals will invest $550 million to develop the Laldia Container Terminal in Chattogram, aiming to boost the port's container-handling capacity by 44 percent. The project, part of the European Union's Global Gateway initiative, represents the largest European foreign direct investment in Bangladesh to date.

Ellen MacArthur Foundation promotes wardrobe clear-outs for circularity
stories.summary: The Ellen MacArthur Foundation is advising the fashion industry to leverage consumer wardrobe clear-outs to scale the second-hand market. The initiative aims to capture discarded items to meet the growing demand for circular fashion products.

stories.title: Circular fashion gains ground as EU pushes fewer collections - Fibre2Fashion
BII backs new fund to support sustainable fashion choices for UK consumers - British International Investment
UK government plans mandatory human rights due diligence
stories.summary: The UK government has announced plans for mandatory human rights due diligence legislation for large businesses. Fashion Roundtable CEO Tamara Cincik described the move as a seismic shift, requiring companies to identify and address exploitation within their operations and global supply chains.

stories.title: Climate and biodiversity conferences conclude with limited progress
stories.summary: Recent UN conferences on biodiversity and climate ended with modest roadmaps rather than major new deals. Despite clear scientific consensus and available solutions, the events highlighted a persistent gap between global climate goals and the political will required to fund and enforce them.

stories.title: Envision Energy and Greensole launch circularity initiative
stories.summary: Envision Energy India and the Greensole Foundation have launched a CSR programme in Chennai to distribute school kits to children. The initiative uses a circular model to convert discarded textiles and footwear into school bags and mats, aiming to address waste while supporting local communities.

stories.title: H&M opens secondhand store in historic Lisbon building
stories.summary: H&M has reopened its store in the former Grandella Department Store in Lisbon, a building that has operated as a retail space since 1907. The renovated site now features a dedicated section for secondhand fashion, marking a new chapter for the historic Art Nouveau location.

stories.title: Toad&Co emphasizes outdoor access and social responsibility
stories.summary: US apparel brand Toad&Co is promoting its outdoor-focused clothing line alongside its partnerships with non-profit organizations. The company maintains a Good rating from the Good On You assessment system, which evaluates brands based on their environmental impact and social responsibility efforts.

stories.title: Consumer group advises caution ahead of Black Friday
stories.summary: As Black Friday approaches, consumer advocates are encouraging shoppers to question their purchasing habits to avoid marketing hype. Despite the ongoing cost-of-living crisis driving demand for discounts, experts suggest a more conscious approach to consumerism to counter the global spread of the retail event.

stories.title: Amazon reports $27 billion in cumulative Indian exports
stories.summary: Amazon says its Global Selling programme has facilitated $27 billion in cumulative exports from India since 2015. The company aims to reach $80 billion by 2030, supported by a base of 2.4 lakh exporters across 28 states. The programme has sold over one billion products worldwide.

stories.summary: Amazon has recorded $27 billion in cumulative e-commerce exports from India through its Global Selling programme since its 2015 launch, advancing toward its target of $80 billion by 2030. stories.title: Uniqlo India reports 44 percent revenue growth
stories.summary: Uniqlo India reported revenues of 1,724 crore rupees in FY26, a 44 percent increase year-on-year. The company, which entered the market in 2019, noted that same-store sales growth reached 20 percent. It intends to accelerate its retail expansion to capture further growth in the country.

stories.title: IKEA India revenue reaches 2,100 crore rupees
stories.summary: IKEA India reported a 14 percent revenue increase to 2,100 crore rupees for FY26. The retailer also brought forward its profitability target by one year, now aiming to reach the goal by FY29. Operational efficiency and cost management were cited as contributors to the improved EBITDA.

Agilitas appoints Prateek Kotha as brand director
stories.summary: Agilitas has appointed Prateek Kotha as brand director. Kotha brings 16 years of experience in brand strategy and retail, including roles at Myntra and ace turtle. He joins the company following an independent consulting stint. His career began in 2009 at the All India Congress Committee.

stories.title: Swedish delegation visits Vancot Limited
stories.summary: A delegation from the Swedish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Swisscontact visited Vancot Limited on 24 November 2026. The factory is a LEED Gold-certified winner of the InSPIRE Challenge, which aims to accelerate the green transition of the garment sector. The factory is now officially green.

stories.title: Lengow acquires DAILY&CO
stories.summary: Lengow has acquired marketplace integration provider DAILY&CO. Lengow describes itself as the leading intelligent ecommerce automation platform. The acquisition aims to provide a single access point to Europe's 1.5 billion monthly marketplace visitors. The two companies have a long-established working relationship.

stories.title: Dick's Sporting Goods supports Nike's Jordan strategy
stories.summary: Executive Chairman Edward Stack has applauded Nike for its long-term approach regarding the Jordan brand. The comments follow reports of progress at Foot Locker. Nike continues to focus on the brand's long-term trajectory.

Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to exit
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is set to step down after 11 years. The company stated that his successor will be named in the coming weeks. Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan will oversee operations in the interim. During his tenure, the business grew more than five-fold.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO to step down amid reported leadership friction
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down after 11 years. Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan will lead in the interim. Reports suggest the departure follows differences with Walmart leadership over delayed IPO plans and liquidity events. The company is currently searching for a successor.
